name: getUpdateSalaryGrade
description: This tool updates salary grades. It first executes the getEIMAttributeList function to retrieve the related data for the update. If any required fields are missing, the tool will fetch the necessary information using the getEIMAttributeList function. If all arguments are provided, it will retrieve the existing data through the getEIMAttributeList API, allowing the user to cross-check the fields before updating. Additionally, it displays a list of currencies, enabling the user to select a currency name and fetch the corresponding value using the getEIMAttributeList API. and if the user update currency user prompt then return keyword is "updateCurrency" other wise user update the currency no return the keyword.
